config.design: 32train and16validation documents, disjoint from H764 gradient and H765 validation panels respectively. Same24 independent isotropic random directions across96contexts. Observe first12 curvatures to predict remaining12. Fit static per-direction mean, scalar context gain, scalar plus rank2 ridge residual, and scalar plus full ridge residual on training documents only. No validation model selection.
config.limitations: Documents already belong to natural research pool. Requires model probes at evaluation time; not an activation-only predictor or featurizer. Fixed small random bank not full metric. Pooled two lengths; no original reserved-test usage.
